source.title: Glimmer of Fire — Wowhead firsthand comment
source.author: Catarra

notes: Primal Fire Storm glimmer; one-time, requires Dragon Isles Enchanting (25) and historically Insight of the Blue > Primal Extraction to obtain. One commenter reported a temporary disenchant error, so do not mark the item permanently non-disenchantable. Dragon Isles Enchanting Knowledge is a non-tradable profession knowledge currency, not an item; Artisan's Mettle is soulbound. These outputs must not be priced as auctionable materials. Unknown per-cast occurrence counts remain null.
